title: fix(tooling): re-tally @objectstack/plugin-auth's TEST_DEBT from tsc
body:
Fixes #10615

`@objectstack/plugin-auth`'s `TEST_DEBT` entry recorded `errors: 109`, a pile tsc no longer finds. It is re-tallied here from one measurement: **97**, with the composition and the per-file split taken from that same tsc run rather than rescaled onto it.

## The measurement

One command, on a fully built workspace closure, under the shared verify lock:

```
bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh -c \
  "NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 pnpm -s check:type-check-debt"
```

Its own informational line, before this change:

> `@objectstack/plugin-auth: TEST_DEBT records 109, tsc now reports 97 (-12)`

The composition and the per-file split below are tallied from the raw diagnostics of **that same `tsc` invocation** — the gate's own generated project (the package `tsconfig.json` with the `"**/*.test.ts"` exclusion lifted, workspace imports resolving through each dependency's built `dist/*.d.ts`), counted with the gate's own rule (`TSC_ERROR_LINE`, TS6059 dropped).

```
TS2493 x36  TS18048 x24  TS2322 x11  TS2532 x9  TS2345 x4  TS2339 x3
TS2554 x3   TS2741 x3    TS7006 x2   TS2769 x1  TS6133 x1        = 97
```

Per file — **complete**, 11 files summing to 97, not a top-four:

| n | file (`src/`) | | n | file (`src/`) |
|--:|---|---|--:|---|
| 43 | `auth-manager.test.ts` | | 3 | `sso-client-secret-at-rest.test.ts` |
| 18 | `admin-user-endpoints.test.ts` | | 2 | `auth-manager.jwt-eddsa-fallback.test.ts` |
| 12 | `auth-plugin.test.ts` | | 2 | `reconcile-membership.test.ts` |
| 11 | `admin-import-users.test.ts` | | 1 | `better-auth-schema-parity.test.ts` |
| 3 | `objectql-adapter.test.ts` | | 1 | `last-admin-guard.test.ts` |
| | | | 1 | `oauth-provider-schema-parity.test.ts` |

## The -12 is measured, not subtracted

`109 - 11 = 98` is the arithmetic that looks right, and it is wrong twice over: the surplus was 11 when the card was filed and 12 when last swept. Cross-tabbing the recorded measurement against this one **by file and by code** attributes every one of the 12:

| file | code | 109 | 97 | Δ |
|---|---|--:|--:|--:|
| `admin-import-users.test.ts` | TS2339 | 5 | 0 | -5 |
| `admin-import-users.test.ts` | TS2493 | 13 | 7 | -6 |
| `auth-manager.test.ts` | TS2345 | 1 | 0 | -1 |

The 11 are #10614 giving two engine doubles real typed parameters — a zero-parameter mock has a zero-length parameter tuple, so every `.mock.calls[0][1]` was a TS2493 and every `options?.where` off it a TS2339. The 12th is one TS2345 at `auth-manager.test.ts(4086,46)` that left afterwards, across three commits that rewrote 204 lines of that file; it is **not** attributed further rather than guessed.

## Correction: the predicted per-file split was wrong

The card named `admin-import-users.test.ts` **and** `admin-user-endpoints.test.ts` as "exactly the two files that moved". `admin-user-endpoints.test.ts` holds **18 at both ends and never moved**. All 11 of #10614's retirements landed in one file.

Re-deriving the whole split is what caught this. Patching the two numbers a reader believes changed would have written a plausible, wrong split over a correct total — the failure this ledger cannot see, since nothing but prose records a split.

## Anchor, re-established before re-tallying

The recorded 109's credibility rests on `d5e7b9f5a1` reproducing it. Measured today at that ref, with the same program shape and the same counting rule:

```
d5e7b9f5a1   109   (recorded: 109)
```

Not only the total — the composition reproduces **class for class** (TS2493 x42, TS18048 x24, TS2322 x11, TS2532 x9, TS2339 x8, TS2345 x5, TS2554 x3, TS2741 x3, TS7006 x2, TS2769 x1, TS6133 x1) and the per-file split reproduces the **44 / 22 / 18 / 12** the note recorded. So the measuring stick did not drift under the entry, and 97 is comparable to 109.

That was worth checking rather than assuming: this gate grew **+1752/-81** since the anchor, and the re-measure path itself did move — `measureTestDebt` now asks `tscErrorCount` to drop TS6059 (#10779), and the `include` roots moved into `includeRoot` (#10876). Neither reaches this package: its output carries **0** TS6059, and `includeRoot` is the previously-inlined expression verbatim (`glob.split('*')[0].replace(/\/$/, '')`). The package's own `tsconfig.json` and the root `tsconfig.json` are both unchanged across the window.

## No `compositionAt`, demonstrated rather than assumed

`--lower` writes `compositionAt` only when a lowering strands a **tier** itemisation. This note's opening tally is per-code, which `tierItemisation` deliberately does not read, so there is nothing to strand and the correct entry carries no such field. Verified by ablation (mutation confirmed on disk, restored under `trap ... EXIT INT TERM`) — injecting `compositionAt: 109` turns the gate red naming this entry:

> ``@objectstack/plugin-auth: TEST_DEBT declares `compositionAt: 109` but its note carries no readable tier itemisation for that number to describe``

That is the check reading the new entry, and reading it correctly.

## Not a graduation

97 is not 0. The entry **stays** and `@objectstack/plugin-auth`'s `typecheck` script is **unchanged**.

## Verification

Gate union derived from the real change set — `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths; it derives from the merge base itself). All run at **`b56b81eb3`**, exit codes captured before any pipe:

| gate | verdict |
|---|---|
| `check:type-check-debt` (ratchet, `--re-measure`) | OK — 32 entries, none above its recorded number |
| `check:type-check-coverage` | OK — self-test 47+59+29+28+19 cases, structural clean |
| `check:cross-package-test-inputs` | OK — 14 packages, all declared |
| `check:entry-guard` | OK — 139 `scripts/` files |
| `check:parse-guard` | OK — 138 `scripts/` files |
| `check:pnpm-filter-targets` | OK — 120/148 filters resolve |
| `check-ci-filter-parity.mjs` | OK — 89 declared globs covered |

The ratchet run confirms the close from the other end: `plugin-auth` no longer appears in the surplus report at all, and the repo-wide surplus falls from **14 raw errors across 3 entries to 2 across 2**.

`scripts/**`-only, so this PR publishes nothing and carries `skip-changeset` rather than a changeset — `.github/workflows/pr-automation.yml`'s `changeset-check` has no path exemption, and `scripts/pr-labels.mjs` never applies that label itself.

⚠️ A re-measure PR is measured against **your branch merged into main**, so a `plugin-auth`-touching PR landing beside this one can redden it. Per the gate's own MERGE QUEUE note, the repair is a new commit carrying a re-measured number — never a re-run, which replays the same stale merge ref.
